summary: Production Needs (PN) feature testing complete. Backend: 11/11 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified working. The PN card displays correctly in Cost & Usage section showing BASE/COMPONENT recipes that need to be produced. Create Production Batch functionality works from both Cost & Usage and Event Detail pages.

generate_purchase_list_production_needs.details: POST /api/events/generate-purchase-list returns production_needs array with correct structure. Shows 'Salsa Madre' (BASE type) with qty_needed: 49.5L, in_stock: 6.2, to_produce: 43.3L, total_cost: $151.55

suggest_from_events_endpoint.details: POST /api/production/suggest-from-events returns suggested_lines with recipe_id, recipe_name, recipe_type (base/component), qty_needed, yield_unit, events_using. Works for single and multiple events.

production_batch_creation.details: POST /api/production/batches creates production batch with lines. Returns batch_id, batch_number (PROD-2026-XXXX), status: PLANNED, lines array.

cost_usage_pn_card.details: Production Needs (PN) card displays in Cost & Usage section when events are selected and purchase list is generated. Shows recipe name, type (BASE), qty to produce, current stock, total cost. Create Batch button opens dialog.

event_detail_production_button.details: Create Production Batch button appears on Event Detail page for Committed/Won events. Button has data-testid='create-production-batch-btn'. Clicking opens dialog with suggested production lines.

production_dialog_functionality.details: Create Production Batch dialog shows: Recipe table (name, type, qty), 'This will create' info (production lines count, PLANNED status, linked event). Cancel and Create Batch buttons work correctly.

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_BATCH production batch during testing (cleaned up after test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Production Needs (PN) feature fully implemented and working. The feature calculates BASE/COMPONENT recipes that need to be produced for events.
